start_time.description: The value to assign to the time_usage_started property of this RequestSummarizedUsagesDetails.UTC date must have the right precision: hours, minutes, seconds, and second fractions must be 0

end_time.description: The value to assign to the time_usage_ended property of this RequestSummarizedUsagesDetails.UTC date must have the right precision: hours, minutes, seconds, and second fractions must be 0

group_by.description: Aggregate the result by.Allows values are “tagNamespace”, “tagKey”, “tagValue”, “service”,“skuName”, “skuPartNumber”, “unit”, “compartmentName”, “compartmentPath”, “compartmentId”“platform”, “region”, “logicalAd”, “resourceId”, “tenantId”, “tenantName”

granularity.description: Allowed values for this property are: "HOURLY", "DAILY", "MONTHLY". Default: "DAILY"

is_aggregate_by_time.description: Specifies whether aggregated by time. If isAggregateByTime is true,all usage or cost over the query time period will be added up.
